description:
A big one. HushMessenger goes from 21 to 27 patches.

**New**

- Three privacy switches, all off by default. **Hide read receipts** works in end-to-end encrypted chats too, but there Messenger marks a chat read and sends the receipt in one step, so chats you open stay unread until you reply. **Keep unsent messages** keeps what other people unsend and marks it "[unsent]". It can't cover end-to-end encrypted chats. **Allow screenshots** lifts the screenshot block in vanish mode and encrypted chats.
- **Use system emoji** draws emoji with your phone's font instead of Messenger's.
- A **HushMessenger** row right under Settings in the Menu tab.
- Re-signed builds no longer open to a blank screen. The fix answers Messenger's check of its own certificate and nothing else.
- Each switch shows when it last took effect, and the App tab can export and import your choices.
- Crash-loop safe mode turns every switch off if Messenger keeps closing right after it starts. Your choices stay saved.
- An optional update check in the App tab. It's off by default, and nothing is sent while it's off.
- Support for build 346013442 from APKPure.

**Better**

- **Hide typing indicator** now works in end-to-end encrypted chats, which is most one-to-one chats. Before, the other person still saw "is typing" there.
- **Hide Meta AI** also removes the "Ask Meta AI" button in search. **Hide avatar stickers** also covers Messenger's newer sticker keyboard.
- Other apps can no longer restart Messenger.
- Lots of settings polish: screen reader labels, focus rings, theme fixes and right-to-left layout.

**Updating**

Refresh the HushMessenger source in Morphe, patch Messenger again with the same key and install it over your current copy. Then use Restart Messenger. Builds 346013354 and 346013370 are still rejected before any change, because their original APKs are needed first (issues #1 and #3). Signing in with "Continue as" through a patched Facebook app still fails on the Facebook side. That fix is coming in Hushfacebook.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.md).

patches.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches.description: Removes the low-memory eligibility limit on Android 11 and newer. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes screenshot restrictions in vanish mode and E2EE chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches.description: Hides the generated-sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches.description: Hides suggested replies in business conversations. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides business suggestions as you type. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches.description: Hides the Chat Moments entry in the menu. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide chat promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners inside conversations. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide event prompts
patches.description: Hides event quick-promotion prompts inside chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches.description: Hides Facebook toolbar, profile and sharing shortcuts. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide friend request cards
patches.description: Hides friend request cards inside the inbox. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide growth prompts
patches.description: Hides the inbox's add-more-people promotion unit. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox ads
patches.description: Filters typed inbox ad items. Live ad removal still needs an affected-account check. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners in the chat list. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches.description: Hides the Home and Channels subtabs. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Hides the floating button, toolbar button, menu entries and search AI. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide People You May Know
patches.description: Hides suggested people in chats and on the Notifications tab. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Suppresses your outgoing read receipt. In end-to-end encrypted chats, chats you open stay unread until you reply. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Reels badge
patches.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide stories and notes
patches.description: Hides the horizontal tray above chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Suppresses your outgoing active-typing signal, including in end-to-end encrypted chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches.description: Renames two shared permissions so a re-signed Messenger can install beside Meta apps. Checked 580 builds only. Earlier clean installs stopped at a blank first-run screen.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Preserves messages other people remove for everyone, except in end-to-end encrypted chats. Your own unsend ability may be limited while active. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Open settings from menu
patches.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to the Menu tab. Always on.

patches.name: Open web links externally
patches.description: Uses Messenger's external-browser branch for HTTP and HTTPS links. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Answers Messenger's own signer lookup with the original Meta certificate. Always on.

patches.name: Use system emoji
patches.description: Renders emoji with the phone's own font instead of Messenger's. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.
